data.long_meaning: A beautiful and graceful name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Naz', which means adorned. This name is often given to girls, signifying their beauty and elegance. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name Nazriya is blessed with the power to attract prosperity and good fortune. The name Nazriya carries the meaning “Graceful, adorned with flowers” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nazriya usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, adorned with flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
